summary: Pacira BioSciences filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results. Stockholders approved an amendment to the 2014 Employee Stock Purchase Plan, increasing authorized shares by 800,000. The board also disclosed committee reassignments. The filing is a routine disclosure of shareholder votes and internal governance changes, with no special situation such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. No deal terms, premium, or transaction-related events are present.
